planner_note: What went wrong: the staging named no side for anyone, and the model's taxi defaults are the London cab / New York checker (chequered band, right-hand drive), so it put the driver on the RIGHT and the passenger behind him on the LEFT — both wrong for Lithuania, which drives on the right with the driver on the left (Soviet-built cars were all left-hand drive). Naming the sides and moving the chequered band outside removes the cue. Pointing ahead was also why QA read 'Go straight ahead'; the sideways point at a doorway level with the car is the 'stop here' cue.
